tuning_policy: Held-out set. Do not tune prompts, tools, thresholds or labels against individual items. The only permitted use is the aggregate scorer report and its per-question check output.
phase_policy: Resolved from the question text: a specific game is that game; overall/including playoffs/all phases means every phase; a question naming both regular season and playoffs reports both; an explicit phase wins; an opponent question spans every phase; a date window is the window; a relative window spans every phase; otherwise the season-level default is the regular season. Player averages count only appearances (minutes > 0).
